meta.use_when: You need a compliance banner offering accept, reject, and preferences choices.
meta.not_for: the message is informational only and doesn't require an explicit accept/reject decision → announcement-banner; the message is a local, in-page status, not a site-wide compliance notice → alerts

docs: A cookie consent banner offering accept, reject, and preferences actions. Do: "Reject non-essential" gets the same one-click ease as "Accept all" — both are top-level buttons, not one button plus a buried settings link. Don't: Make rejecting cookies harder to find or reach than accepting them — that's a dark pattern, not a real choice. Use announcement-banner when the message is informational only and doesn't require an explicit accept/reject decision. Use alerts when the message is a local, in-page status, not a site-wide compliance notice.
